title: David Beckham’s company DB Ventures sues after fragrances allegedly found for sale in Poundland
summary: Coty has produced Beckham’s fragrances since 2005, under a licence with the ex-footballer’s company DB Ventures and Authentic Brands

extraction.key_fact: 데이비드 베컴의 회사 DB 벤처스가 자사 향수가 파운드랜드에서 팔렸다는 주장과 관련해 소송을 냈다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: David Beckham’s company DB Ventures sues after fragrances allegedly found for sale in Poundland
